name: "Survey / Research"
about: "Investigate a question or run a bounded experiment."
title: "[SURVEY] research(scope): state the question"
labels: "research"
---

## Classification
- Type: Survey
- Method: Research or experiment; use experiment in the title for measured work
- Status: Draft

## Why
State the question or falsifiable hypothesis and why its answer matters.

## Outcome
State the decision this evidence should support. Replace planned outcomes
with supported findings only after the investigation.

## Scope
- Sources, fixed revisions, inputs, and controls:
- Measurements and denominators, when relevant:
- Excluded work:

## Project metadata
- Primary label: research
- Project: not configured, unless explicitly assigned

## Acceptance
- [ ] Answer the question with inspectable evidence.
- [ ] Separate facts, inference, failures, unknowns, and NOT RUN checks.

## Dependencies and boundary
State the budget, stopping condition, and conditions for revisiting the
conclusion. This Issue does not authorize implementation or production changes.

## Evidence
Keep sources, reproducible commands or run references, results, limitations,
and the keep / adapt / reject / unknown conclusion in this same Issue.
